title: Shared building blocks of the medical device profile meddevice.v1

subject.description: Subject identifier, 32 bytes hexadecimal - the same format as the subj field in the entry.

timestamp.description: Point in time in the real world, RFC 3339 with time zone.

party.description: Party involved. Names of natural persons - patients above all - do not belong in here; the profile knows only operations: manufacturers, facilities, servicers (spec Sec.9).

srn.description: EUDAMED Single Registration Number, where the party is a registered economic operator.

product.description: One serialized device or component - always instance level, this profile has no lot stage (spec Sec.3).

udi_di.description: UDI Device Identifier - the model-level identifier, the primary key in EUDAMED/GUDID.

udi_pi.description: UDI Production Identifier for this specific unit - a serial number throughout this profile's scope (spec Sec.3).

device_type.description: Free-text device type, e.g. "MRI scanner", "hip stem implant".

expiry.description: Shelf-life expiry, for sterile devices where applicable.

item.description: Reference to another subject, optionally with device details.
